title: q2netcdf: Python tools for Rockland Scientific Q-files
description:
Python tools for reading, parsing, and converting Rockland Scientific Q-files, the binary turbulence data product generated by the ISDP data logger, into CF-compliant NetCDF.

The package implements the Q-file binary format described in Rockland Technical Note TN-054, supporting format versions 1.2 and 1.3, and maps over 200 sensor identifier codes to named variables with CF metadata. It provides both a Python API and command-line tools for converting Q-files to NetCDF (q2netcdf), inspecting headers and data records (QHeader, QFile), reducing and merging Q-files for bandwidth-limited platforms such as Slocum gliders carrying a MicroRider (QReduce, mergeqfiles), and generating ISDP configuration files (mkISDPcfg).
